thread:
Maya R: Heads up — planning a staged rollout of the v2 API tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need quick preflight: SDK header ready, rollout cadence, telemetry thresholds, and clear rollback criteria.
Alex P: Ack. SDK already has opt-in header but we need to force-ship patch to log missing headers for 48h.
Rachel S: I can publish the SDK patch today. Will add a deprecation warning and a flag to opt into v2 by default.
Emily H: Telemetry plan: we'll track 5xx rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, and token generation error ratio. I propose immediate rollback if 5xx rate increases by >150% and absolute >1.5% over baseline for 5 continuous mins, or p99 latency jumps +50ms sustained for 5m.
Jon T: Also monitor model-quality regressions: generated-response BLEU-like score and a small prompt test set. If quality falls >10% on core prompts, we pause.
Dave K: Infra notes: canary path will be 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~90m with manual pause points. We have capacity to keep node pool at 1.2x for bursting.
Maya R: Rollout policy: route by header `x-rw-api-version: 2`. Clients without header continue to v1. We will also expose an override header `x-rw-api-pin: v1` for emergency pinning. Include those in release notes.
Rachel S: Release notes draft: short migration section + example curl with header. I'll add SDK compatibility table and example fallback snippet. Link: https://go.redwood/release/v2-migration (draft).
ci-bot: CI status: integration tests green on main, canary tests passing.
deploy-bot: Initiating canary rollout: v2 -> 5% traffic (region: us-east-1). Started at 2123456900.
Alex P: After canary starts, watch 5m buckets for any 5xx spikes. Emily, can you wire dashboard alerts to #incidents and this thread?
Emily H: On it. Alerts: 5xx absolute >1.5% (5m), 5xx delta >+100% (5m), p99 latency +50ms (5m), QA prompt fail rate >10% (continuous 10m). Alerts will include a link to the quick rollback runbook.
Jon T: Rollback criteria confirmed. Who's the on-call to flip pins?
Dave K: Infra on-call (me) will have permission to set gateway fallback and trigger `x-rw-api-pin: v1` at the gateway if needed. Rachel can push SDK hotfix. Maya will coordinate comms.
Maya R: Communication plan: post release notes + #product channel announcement at start. If we hit any threshold, escalate to execs after 30m.
Rachel S: SDK patch ready: published to npm and pypi under 1.3.2. It wraps requests with header helper and logs missing header to telemetry.
Alex P: Minor request — add a log tag `deploy:v2-canary` to all calls so we can slice metrics easily.
Emily H: Added. Dashboards updated with `deploy:v2-canary` dimension.
deploy-bot: Canary at 5% healthy for 15m. Metrics: 5xx=0.2% (baseline 0.15%), p99 +8ms, QA prompt delta +1.2%. Continue to 25%?
Maya R: Proceed to 25% if no alert in the next 10m.
Dave K: Rolling to 25% now.
ci-bot: Smoke tests on 25% segment passed.
deploy-bot: 25% steady for 20m. Metrics stable: 5xx=0.25%, p99 +12ms. No QA regressions flagged.
Jon T: Sounds good. Plan to 100% after 45m observation window. Final go/no-go at that point.
Maya R: Agreed. I'll start the announcement when we hit 100%. Rachel, please have SDK update notice queued.
Rachel S: Will do.
Emily H: One more safety net — added a synthetic traffic job hitting core prompts every 30s; if any fail we auto-trigger a high-severity alert.
Alex P: Also: document the emergency header to ops runbook: `curl -H "x-rw-api-pin: v1" https://gateway.redwood/api`
Maya R: Thanks everyone. If there are no objections, proceed with this plan.
Jon T: No objections from product.
Dave K: Ops ready.
Rachel S: SDK note published.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% at 2123456950. No critical alerts during rollout.
Maya R: Closing thread — will open a postmortem if any anomalies show in next 24h. Post rollout checklist: update changelog, close dev tickets, and notify enterprise customers using self-hosted connectors.
ci-bot: Post-deploy tests scheduled for +1h.
Emily H: I'll keep the synthetic monitors for 24h and report any signal drift in #eng-sre.
Dave K: Leaving a note: if any customer reports a missing header issue, use `deploy:v2-canary` logs to correlate and then advise SDK bump.
Maya R: Thanks all :tada:
